scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Reconstruction of Function Fields from Mod-ℓ Milnor K-Theory” (preprints/Reconstruction-of-Function-Fields-from-Mod-ell-Milnor-K-Theory-October-5-2026/mod-ell-bogomolov-pop.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 009 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 fafdf71eafc4700a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let ℓ be any prime. Let K/k and L/l be finitely generated extensions of arbitrary algebraically closed fields, with char k, char l ̸= ℓ and trdeg(K/k), trdeg(L/l) ≥ 2. Then (1.1) is bijective. In particular, a compatible isomorphism VK → VL forces equality of the characteristics and of the relative transcendence degrees.
